Lab: A Noisy Tenant in a Fixed Service Window

Which tenant gets the fixed service?

Finite time-zero burst; equal one-second jobs; 12 queued jobs per tenant; A/B/C insertion order; B/C offer six each; WRR weights 2:1:1. Retry copies use unsafe fresh keys. No distributed or variable-token fairness claim.
